title: testuserauthenticationwithemailpasswordandoauth
description: Verify user authentication functionality including login and registration using email/password and OAuth providers such as GitHub and Google, ensuring session persistence and secure handling.

title: testdocumentmanagementwithrichtexteditorandaiasistance
description: Validate document creation, editing, and saving features with the rich text editor supporting headings, lists, code blocks, inline AI writing commands, and auto-save functionality.

title: testkanbantaskmanagementwithdraganddroppriorityandassignment
description: Test the Kanban-style task board for creating, prioritizing, assigning tasks to AI agents or users, setting due dates, and drag-and-drop task movement between columns.

title: testaiagentsworkflowexecutionandhistorytracking
description: Ensure AI agents (Supervisor, Researcher, Writer, Coder, Project Manager) can execute workflows with real-time progress updates, history tracking, output viewing, and support retry and cancel operations.

title: testaichatinterfacewithmultipleagentmodesandmessagefunctionality
description: Verify AI chat interface supports multiple agent modes, maintains message history, and provides copy and retry options for AI-generated responses.

title: testusersettingsprofileaimodelapikeynotificationsandappearance
description: Check user settings functionality including profile updates, AI model configuration, API key management with encryption, notification preferences, theme selection, and sync options.

title: testglobalcommandpaletteforquicknavigationandactions
description: Validate the global command palette allows users to quickly navigate through the application and perform actions efficiently with keyboard shortcuts and search capabilities.

title: testlandingpagecontentdisplayandresponsiveness
description: Verify the marketing landing page displays hero section, stats, bento gallery, features, testimonials, and footer correctly and is responsive across devices.

title: testdashboarddisplayofstatsagentactivitydocumentsandtasks
description: Ensure the main dashboard correctly displays user stats, AI agent activity, recent documents, priority tasks, and quick action buttons in the bento grid layout.

title: testsecurityfeaturesincludingapikeyencryptionhttpsandcsrfprotection
description: Test security features such as encrypted API keys, HTTPS enforcement, secure cookies, CSRF protection, input sanitization, and rate limiting to protect user data and application integrity.
